description: Shared definitions for Shellf's experimental records.

content.description: A canonical TMDB identity. TV episodes also carry their parent show and episode coordinates so they can be resolved through TMDB's nested episode API.

id.description: The numeric TMDB movie, show, or episode identifier.

showId.description: Required by the AppView when kind is tv_episode; the parent show's numeric TMDB identifier.

seasonNumber.description: Required by the AppView when kind is tv_episode.

episodeNumber.description: Required by the AppView when kind is tv_episode.
